name: Comb
author: Erin Carter
description: A strict honeycomb of flat hexagonal cells lit from within by a slow-drifting light field — bright clusters of warm comb shade off into dim neighbours across thin dark wax walls, while a few vacated chambers sit dark and re-light over long staggered periods.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Width of one hexagon in CSS pixels; small cells read as fine honeycomb texture, large cells as bold architectural panels.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Drift rate of the light field through the comb — how quickly the lit region migrates from cell to cell.

params.label: Vacancy
params.effect: Fraction of cells that go fully dark as empty chambers; 0 keeps every cell live, 0.5 hollows out half the comb.
